app.name: AgricNorthX
app.tagline: Local harvest. Smarter decisions. Better markets.
app.translationNotice: This translation is in progress and has not yet been reviewed by fluent speakers. Some screens are still in English.

dashboard.qaRegisterHint: Add a farmer to your network

earnings.heading: Sales & earnings
earnings.sub: Added up from what you have recorded in Bookkeeping, including fulfilled orders.
earnings.noneTitle: No sales or expenses recorded yet
earnings.noneBody: Record a sale or an expense to see your income, costs and profit here. Fulfilled orders are added automatically.
earnings.unavailableTitle: Earnings are not available right now
earnings.unavailableBody: Your records are safe. Please try again in a few minutes.
earnings.unpaid: Still to be paid to you

products.libraryIntro: Browse product information. Each item shows its access level before you open its detailed guidance.
products.libraryEmpty: No library guides have been published yet. Your own products are listed above.
products.heading: My products
products.sub: Everything you sell. Edit details, change photos, pause or remove a product.
products.emptyTitle: You have not listed any products yet
products.emptyBody: Add your first product with a photo, price and quantity so buyers can find it.
products.removeConfirm: Remove “{name}”? If it already has orders it will be paused instead, so order history is kept.
products.noticePaused: This product already has orders or requests, so it was paused and hidden from the marketplace. Order history is kept.
products.loadError: We could not load your products. Please try again.
products.actionError: That action could not be completed. Please try again.
products.libraryError: The product catalogue is not available yet. Please try again later.

market.title: The local harvest marketplace
market.intro: Discover fresh produce listed by local farmers. Compare availability and asking prices, then send a request when you are ready to buy.
market.created: Your produce listing has been published.
market.loadError: We could not load the marketplace. Please try again shortly.
market.emptyBody: Try a different crop, locality or price range. Farmers can add new harvests at any time.
market.disclaimer: Prices, quantities and quality notes are supplied by farmers and are not independently verified. Confirm quality, collection arrangements and final price with the seller before payment. AgricNorthX does not hold payments.

auth.loginIntro: Sign in to manage your harvest or find local produce.
auth.registered: Account created. Check your email if confirmation is required, then sign in.
auth.loginError: We could not sign you in. Check your details and try again.
auth.registerIntro: Create a farmer or buyer account for the Vhembe pilot.
auth.registerError: Registration could not be completed. Check the details or contact the pilot team.
auth.consent: I agree to the account data being used to provide AgricNorthX services. I understand I can request access, correction or deletion subject to lawful retention.
